definitions: According to what one remembers or can recall.
Based on one's memory, which may not be perfect.
examples: To the best of my recollection, the meeting was on Tuesday.
She stated, to the best of her recollection, that he was not present.
To the best of one's recollection, the key was left on the table.
lemma: to the best of one's recollection
synonyms: as far as one can recall
source: to the best of one's recollection
